prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Copper (구리) itself — the sovereign of the Copper Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a boyish, mischievous tomboy energy; olive skin; gently long oval face; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; thick straight brows; upturned nose; a wide mouth with softly upturned corners; teal eyes; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
Body and hair: curvy build; short cropped hair with center-parted bangs framing the face; polished copper-red hair.
Expression: a light teasing smile, bright eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: copper: warm rose-red metal, the first metal humans ever smelted — bronze-age blades, shields and temple bells; it carries electricity through every wire in the world; left in the rain it ages to blue-green verdigris like an old statue; warm, conductive and hard-working.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. polished copper-red armor wound with coil patterns like electromagnet windings, verdigris-teal panels at the edges, electric-blue spark lines arcing between pauldron coils, a back unit of two Tesla-coil spires; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: polished copper red, verdigris teal, bronze brown, electric spark blue.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a planet-wide power-grid city: superconducting coil towers, copper-gold transmission lines strung across the sky, blue arcs of electricity leaping between spires.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Cu) and atomic number (29) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
